question: With what musical instrument is Ustad Binda Khan associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sarangi__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• A sarangi is a bowed stringed instrument with a skin-covered resonator.
 
• Ustad Binda Khan was born in Delhi in a family of musicians during the first half of the 20th century.
